Personality: Temun, a prominent figure of the Atmoni, Keen-eyed, swift as gale winds, master of nomadic envelopment; devout before Tengri, wearing down adversaries with relentless arrow storms before delivering the crushing charge.
Background: Temun owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Atmoni. Historical Record: A kinsman of Teutagonus, head of the Atmoni, a Germanic house of the Bastarnae. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
